title: Personal Credit Cards: Annual Percentage Rates by Tier
content:
The rates below are the annual percentage rates (APRs) that apply across the tiers of Personal Credit Cards: the purchase APR range within which an approved account is priced, the cash advance APR, and the penalty APR together with the lateness that triggers it and the run of on-time payments that removes it.

| Tier | Purchase APR, lowest | Purchase APR, highest | Cash advance APR | Penalty APR | Days a minimum payment is past due before the penalty APR applies | Consecutive on-time minimum payments that remove it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 26.49 percent | 26.49 percent | 29.49 percent | 29.99 percent | 60 | 6 |
| College Rewards Visa | 21.49 percent | 28.49 percent | 29.49 percent | 29.99 percent | 60 | 6 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 15.24 percent | 24.24 percent | 28.99 percent | 29.99 percent | 60 | 6 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 19.24 percent | 28.24 percent | 29.49 percent | 29.99 percent | 60 | 6 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 20.24 percent | 28.24 percent | 29.49 percent | 29.99 percent | 60 | 6 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 18.24 percent | 25.24 percent | 27.49 percent | not applicable | 60 | 6 |

## Notes on the table

- Secured Visa has a single purchase APR, because the lowest and highest figures coincide.
- Visa Infinite Private Client carries no penalty APR at all; the lateness and cure figures shown for it therefore never produce a penalty rate on that tier.
- The cash advance APR is fixed by tier rather than chosen within a range.

> Hypothetical illustration: a Cash Rewards Visa account approved at 22.99 percent sits inside that tier's range of 19.24 to 28.24 percent; an approval at 14.99 percent would lie outside it.
